description: Add tests for side_effects module (base, notification, stats_collector, webhook_callback) - 148 lines at 0% coverage. Tests the SideEffectRunner concurrent execution, NotificationSideEffect threshold logic, StatsCollector aggregation, and WebhookCallback delivery.
steps: Create helper fixtures: a mock PipelineContext with a ScoreResult (overall_score, labels, dimensions) and a Content (title, source_url, text, content_hash). Import from src.core.pipeline and src.models.score.

Test SideEffectRunner: register() adds effects, run_all() calls should_trigger then execute for triggered effects, effects that fail should_trigger are skipped, effects that raise in execute are caught (error isolation), untriggered effects are not executed

Test NotificationSideEffect: should_trigger returns True when score < threshold, should_trigger returns False when score >= threshold, should_trigger returns False when result is None, execute logs warning with correct info, execute calls webhook when webhook_url configured (mock httpx)

Test StatsCollectorSideEffect: should_trigger returns True when result is not None, execute increments total_scored and total_score_sum, execute tracks per-source scores (parse hostname from source_url), execute tracks label counts, get_stats() returns correct aggregates, reset() clears all state

Test WebhookCallbackSideEffect: should_trigger returns True when result exists, execute POSTs correct payload to callback_url (mock httpx), execute with include_content=True includes text_preview, execute handles httpx failure gracefully (logs warning, no exception)
